# Alpha Cut Video Editing Agency

> Boutique video editing agency specializing in high-retention short-form content, viral animation breakdowns, cinematic edits, and monthly video retainers for tech founders, creators, and growth brands.

## Core Navigation & Pages

- [Homepage](https://alpha-cut.com/): Agency overview, before/after video slider, client testimonials, and feature highlights.
- [Editing Styles](https://alpha-cut.com/editing-styles): Signature editing styles including Educational Animations, Cinematic Shorts, and SaaS Demos.
- [Portfolio](https://alpha-cut.com/portfolio): Filterable video portfolio showcasing high-retention client edits.
- [Packages & Pricing](https://alpha-cut.com/packages): Transparent edit pricing tiers and monthly retainer packages.
- [About Us](https://alpha-cut.com/about): Meet the founders (Amir & Aymen) and agency workflow.
- [Client Ratings](https://alpha-cut.com/ratings): Verified client reviews, aggregate 5.0 rating breakdown, and feedback.
